title: Accounting Standard for Quarterly Financial Reporting
summary: Accounting Standard for Quarterly Financial Reporting is part of the Japan GAAP framework.
description: This standard is part of the Japan GAAP framework issued by the Accounting Standards Board of Japan (ASBJ). It provides guidance on accounting standard for quarterly financial reporting.

bannerNotice.body: This standard has been superseded by newer guidance.
